title: 餐盘栈
summary: 维护容量固定的一排栈；push 总放入最左非满栈，pop 从最右非空栈弹出，popAtStack 从指定栈弹出。
insight: 用有序集合维护所有未满栈下标，push 取最小下标；弹出后把该栈加入未满集合，并及时裁掉尾部空栈，使普通 pop 始终访问最右非空栈。
pitfalls: 中间空洞不能直接删除栈，否则下标会变化
无效下标或空指定栈返回负一

solutions.title: 未满下标有序集合
solutions.idea: 用最小可写下标和紧凑尾部同时满足两种弹出规则。
steps: stacks 保存各栈，available 保存未满栈下标
push：available 空则新建栈，否则取最小下标；压入后若满则移出 available，否则保留
popAtStack：校验后弹出并加入 available，再删除所有尾部空栈及其下标；pop 调用最后一个栈的 popAtStack

code.java: class DinnerPlates { private final int capacity;private final List<ArrayDeque<Integer>> stacks=new ArrayList<>();private final TreeSet<Integer> available=new TreeSet<>();public DinnerPlates(int capacity){this.capacity=capacity;}public void push(int val){int index;if(available.isEmpty()){index=stacks.size();stacks.add(new ArrayDeque<>());}else index=available.first();ArrayDeque<Integer> stack=stacks.get(index);stack.push(val);if(stack.size()==capacity)available.remove(index);else available.add(index);}public int pop(){return stacks.isEmpty()?-1:popAtStack(stacks.size()-1);}public int popAtStack(int index){if(index<0||index>=stacks.size()||stacks.get(index).isEmpty())return -1;int value=stacks.get(index).pop();available.add(index);while(!stacks.isEmpty()&&stacks.get(stacks.size()-1).isEmpty()){int last=stacks.size()-1;stacks.remove(last);available.remove(last);}return value;} }
code.kotlin: class DinnerPlates(private val capacity:Int) { private val stacks=mutableListOf<java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>>();private val available=java.util.TreeSet<Int>();fun push(`val`:Int){val index=if(available.isEmpty()){stacks.add(java.util.ArrayDeque());stacks.lastIndex}else available.first();val stack=stacks[index];stack.push(`val`);if(stack.size==capacity)available.remove(index) else available.add(index)};fun pop():Int=if(stacks.isEmpty())-1 else popAtStack(stacks.lastIndex);fun popAtStack(index:Int):Int{if(index !in stacks.indices||stacks[index].isEmpty())return -1;val value=stacks[index].pop();available.add(index);while(stacks.isNotEmpty()&&stacks.last().isEmpty()){val last=stacks.lastIndex;stacks.removeAt(last);available.remove(last)};return value} }
code.cpp: class DinnerPlates { int capacity;vector<vector<int>> stacks;set<int> available;public:DinnerPlates(int capacity):capacity(capacity){}void push(int val){int index;if(available.empty()){index=stacks.size();stacks.push_back({});}else index=*available.begin();stacks[index].push_back(val);if((int)stacks[index].size()==capacity)available.erase(index);else available.insert(index);}int pop(){return stacks.empty()?-1:popAtStack(stacks.size()-1);}int popAtStack(int index){if(index<0||index>=(int)stacks.size()||stacks[index].empty())return -1;int value=stacks[index].back();stacks[index].pop_back();available.insert(index);while(!stacks.empty()&&stacks.back().empty()){int last=stacks.size()-1;stacks.pop_back();available.erase(last);}return value;} };
